# 🚀 weborbit

> Zero-config project generator for modern JavaScript apps
> Build fast. Learn faster.

---

## ✨ What is weborbit?

**weborbit** is a beginner-friendly CLI tool that helps you create fully structured, modern JavaScript projects in seconds.

No setup. No confusion. Just run and start building.

---

## ⚡ Features

* 🧱 Create projects instantly (React / Vanilla)
* 🎨 Optional Tailwind CSS support
* 🔌 Optional backend (Express)
* 🌑 Modern dark UI starter template
* 📝 Auto-generated README
* 🧠 Beginner-friendly structure
* ⚡ Zero configuration required

---

## 📦 Installation

No install needed — use directly with:

```bash
npx weborbit
```

---

## 🚀 Usage

Run the CLI:

```bash
npx weborbit
```

Then answer simple prompts:

```bash
? Project name → my-app
? Project description → My awesome app
? Framework → React / Vanilla
? Styling → CSS / Tailwind
? Backend → Yes / No
```

---

## 🧪 Example

```bash
npx weborbit my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

---

## 📁 Generated Project Includes

* ⚛️ React or Vanilla setup (Vite)
* 🎨 Clean modern UI (dark theme)
* 🔁 Hot Module Reload (HMR)
* 🧩 Scalable folder structure
* 📝 README file

---

## 🖼 UI Preview

Modern dark-themed starter with branding and clean layout.

---

## 🛠 Tech Stack

* Vite
* React (optional)
* Tailwind CSS (optional)
* Express (optional)

---

## 🎯 Why weborbit?

Most starters are:

* ❌ Overcomplicated
* ❌ Hard to understand

**weborbit solves this:**

* ✅ Simple
* ✅ Clean
* ✅ Ready to build
